title: Text: DET Al Avila ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: My editors are making me write about the Opening Day thing...

Any context would be helpful, no quotes or attribution. Gardenhire said earlier they made a mistake, but I think he was talking about the time limit. MLB said there was conclusive evidence - big surprise - in statement.

There is no issues. They had conclusive evidence to make the call. No more to be said. It's over we accept the verdict. We are moving on. Put it to rest. Let's not have the media use this for its own benefit. At the end we accept and understand the the final call.
